page_title: MAL 2-2 ALM | Mallorca v Almeria 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van Der Heyden S. Shoulder Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.

90+1' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Fernando Martinez! Mallorca will take a corner kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
85' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' 2 - 2 Goal! Antonio Raillo plays a short, square pass into the path of Sergi Darder (Mallorca), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 2:2. Fabulous goal!
82' Pepe Mel has decided to substitute Sergio Arribas and he is replaced by Adrian Embarba (Almeria).
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) is coming onto the pitch as Alejandro Centelles Plaza cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Almeria fail to score from a corner as Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
81' Bruno Langa (Almeria) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Almeria.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
79' The attendance for today's match is 20573.
79' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.

79' Fernando Martinez pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.

79' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Fernando Martinez tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
76' Substitution. Jaume Costa makes way for Toni Lato (Mallorca).
76' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.
73' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 18:4. 3:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
69' It will be a substitution. Nemanja Radonjic (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Jose Copete walks off.

66' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Bruno Langa (Almeria) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Predrag Rajkovic just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
65' Pepe Mel has decided to make a change. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) replaces Luis Suarez.
65' Substitution. Luka Romero did his best and is replaced by Choco Lozano (Almeria).
64' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
63' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Cyle Larin is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
62' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
58' Gonzalo Melero goes off the pitch and Lucas Robertone (Almeria) comes on.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.

57' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Fernando Martinez makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. Mallorca get a corner.
55' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Fernando Martinez (Almeria).

55' What a great touch by Cyle Larin (Mallorca) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Mallorca force a corner. They send men into the box.
52' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Fernando Martinez is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Javier Aguirre probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Samu Costa (Mallorca). He is replaced by Omar Mascarell.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Luka Romero (Almeria) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
45+1' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
41' 1 - 1 Sergio Arribas (Almeria) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
40' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
37' Jose Copete (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card.
34' What a chance that is! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
29' 1 - 0 Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball under the crossbar.
29' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

28' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
26' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

25' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.
21' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar.
18' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) receives a yellow card for infringement.
17' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
11' The linesman signals that Cesar Montes (Almeria) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
2' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
